question.text: Strategy DD for a Cat III AIF should assess:

answer.text: Investment methodology and risk factors including short-position limits, derivative trading, concentration limits, leverage, investment philosophy, investment process and risk management controls

explanation.text: The Logic: Strategy DD should review investment methodology and risk factors — leverage, short-position limits, derivative trading and concentration limits — alongside investment philosophy, investment process and risk management controls. The Trap: Single-factor checks like historical returns, AUM or fees ignore the methodology, risk-factor and process dimensions that the workbook expects. Note: Anchor strategy DD to investment methodology, risk factors (leverage, shorts, derivatives, concentration), philosophy, process and risk controls.
